title: Accountable human and AI collaboration in writing
assignment: Develop an evidence-based argument with generative AI assistance. AI may draft and critique prose. The intended capability includes evaluating AI suggestions, so AI-assisted work is appropriate for part of the assessment.
ai_permissions: Develop an evidence-based argument with generative AI assistance. AI may draft and critique prose. The intended capability includes evaluating AI suggestions, so AI-assisted work is appropriate for part of the assessment.
budget_scope: Additional checkpoint work; existing product marking excluded

requirements.description: Compare a specific AI suggestion with the student’s alternative and justify acceptance or rejection.
verify whether an inspected source supports a claim.
independently apply the argument to an unfamiliar counterexample.

checkpoints.name: Capture paired draft and suggestion
checkpoints.prompt: B: Select one substantive AI suggestion from A, show your alternative and justify the final decision against the rubric. E: Inspect a source excerpt to judge a claim, then respond independently to a new counterexample. A provides material for B but does not itself demonstrate E1. Candidate: Capture paired draft and suggestion.
checkpoints.conditions: E1 Compare a specific AI suggestion with the student’s alternative and justify acceptance or rejection. E2 verify whether an inspected source supports a claim. E3 independently apply the argument to an unfamiliar counterexample. E1 permits documented AI collaboration; E2 and E3 use supervised verification and transfer conditions.
checkpoints.ai_permissions: Develop an evidence-based argument with generative AI assistance. AI may draft and critique prose. The intended capability includes evaluating AI suggestions, so AI-assisted work is appropriate for part of the assessment.
checkpoints.mapping_rationale: AI assistance is not treated as invalid by default. Coverage depends on the intended capability and evidence conditions. Pairing drafts establishes a basis for commentary, not proof of authorship or the quality of the student’s judgment.

expected_narrative: B requires A. The cheapest full-coverage combination is A + B + E at 140 minutes and S = 30. A + B + C + D costs 173 minutes and S = 35, exceeding the teacher time limit. A selection containing B without A must be rejected even if it appears to cover E1. If A is unavailable, full coverage becomes impossible under this library.
